fusions.name: Unimpressed Quack
fusions.desc: Quacks in a 3-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Splashdown
fusions.desc: Drops a burst of water on a target, dealing 26 damage to it and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it, and leaving them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Sticks
fusions.desc: Makes you immune for 4 seconds: blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Millpond Stride

riders.text: you cross it faster than ground
and nothing that wades can pin you down
and it mends you while you float

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 12% faster on it, from silver your dodge chance rises 8%, and from gold your health recovers 20% faster.
